about: Incorporated in the year 1995, G R Infraprojects Ltd is an integrated road Engineering, Procurement, Construction company (EPC) with experience in the design and construction of various road/highway projects across 15 States in India.  It mainly undertakes civil construction projects under the EPC and BOT (Build Operate Transfer) basis in the road sector. [1]
